_comment: The tabla's strokes: each a set of takes (recordings) from the Freesound pack 'tabla bols' by mmiron (CC0, docs/references/tabla_mmiron/). drum: dayan (retuned to Sa) or bayan (its own pitch). level_db: the stroke's level against the others (the pack's files are each normalised to full scale, so the balance between strokes is set here, by ear). Built by tools/tabla_data/build_samples.py into tabla/tabla_samples.h.

TIN._note: the pack has no Tin: na-open stands in (ElectroNick, step 4)

TAS._note: the pack's 'tas': a closed stroke, not mapped to a bol by default

DHEC._note: the pack's 'dhec' (closed): not mapped to a bol by default

GEM._note: Ge with the wrist's glide (meend), the long takes
